ITEM 1 | Loose pile of dark green leafy greens with flat, thin, slightly glossy leaves and pale stems, mixed with some small ruffled light-green leaves and a few thin orange-tinged shredded strands, covering roughly 40% of the plate's left side, about 14 cm long and 3-4 cm tall in mounded layers, moist and limp with no visible dressing pooling | 85

ITEM 2 | Cooked pale golden-cream chicken-like pieces, irregular torn strips about 3-5 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, with slightly browned edges and a glossy, moist sheen, sitting beside and partly over a granular light-brown grain mixture with visible small kernels and specks of orange carrot, covering roughly 25% of the plate's right side, about 4 cm tall in a loose mound | 120

ITEM 3 | Light tan, loose, crumbly granular grain mixture with small distinct kernels and a dry, matte surface, scattered among the chicken pieces and along the plate edge in small clumps, about 1 cm particles, roughly 15% of the plate area, about 1.5 cm tall | 60

ITEM 4 | Thin, dark green wilted leafy pieces with a slightly glossy sheen, interspersed among the chicken and grain on the right side of the plate, about 6-8 cm long strands and small leaves, lying flat, about 0.5 cm thick | 15
